title: Interview: Retail Sales staffing and voice capacity
story: You meet Maya, the retail operations manager. She says Sales is falling behind and customers wait too long.
You will ask questions to learn what she needs. Then you will build the changes in the Contoso environment.

interview.opening: Our Sales queue is falling behind and customers wait too long.

topics.ask: How many people do you think Sales needs on the phones to keep up?
topics.answer: We need at least five people on Sales so calls stop piling up.

topics.ask: When a call comes in, do you want it sent to whoever's been idle longest or the agent with the most free capacity?
topics.answer: Send it to the agent with the most free capacity so busy people don't get more work.

topics.ask: How many calls should each agent be able to handle at once?
topics.answer: Agents should be able to handle up to three work items at the same time.

extras.ask: Do you want Sales to take emails too?
extras.answer: Not right now. We first want to fix voice capacity.

extras.ask: Are there specific people who must stay on Sales?
extras.answer: A few seniors should stay, but we can move others as needed.
